逃离学校 [跑酷版]

 

Welcome to Escape the school parkour edition!

The original escape the school adventure map got over 8000 downloads which is incredible for me as it was my only first adventure map and I wasn't even expecting 50 downloads.

 

For those of you who prefer parkour to puzzle, this is for you.

 

I removed all the puzzles and replaced it with more parkour. Personally, I love parkour, but I have never built a parkour map, so please tell me how you thought this map went.
